scheduler_hint: Switching the scheduler off pauses every scheduled job.
error_unavailable: The orchestrator is not answering. Is it running?
error_timeout: The orchestrator took too long to answer.
error_denied: This screen is not allowed to ask for that.
error_orchestrator: The orchestrator answered with an error: {message}
error_unexpected: The reply was not what this card expects.
memory_similarity_off: Similarity is off: predictions are only the baseline.
memory_similarity_down: Similarity is unavailable: predictions are only the baseline.
memory_needs_reindex: {count} experiences need embedding for this model.
memory_score_failed: The score could not be read: {message}
memory_nothing_scored: Nothing scored yet: no resolved experience has a prediction.
memory_too_few: Too few to judge: {scored} scored, {needed} needed.
memory_brier: Brier score, lower is better: prediction {prediction}, baseline {baseline}.
memory_does_not_beat: Skill {skill}: does not beat the baseline.
knowledge_empty: The Library is empty: drop a file anywhere here, or add a note or a web address.
knowledge_similarity_off: Similarity is off: search matches words only.
knowledge_similarity_down: Similarity is unavailable: search matches words only.
knowledge_none_relevant: No relevant match. These are the closest passages.
digest_no_sources: No source yet. Add a plugin to the feeds service and its items appear here.
digest_not_configured: The feeds service has no plugins directory (FEEDS_PLUGINS_DIR is not set).
digest_directory_error: The plugins directory cannot be read: {message}
digest_none_enabled: No source is enabled. Set "enabled": true in a plugin's manifest.
digest_at_limit: Showing the first {count}. The rest stays in the digest.
memes_tagged_ready: Created {tag}; click Send to post it to Discord.
add_drop_hint: Drop the file to add it to the Library.
add_file_hint: Drop a file here or choose one: text, Markdown, HTML, Word, EPUB, PDF or a feed, up to {size} MB.
add_need_text: Write the text of the note.
add_title_too_long: The title is longer than {max} characters.
add_text_too_long: The text is longer than {max} characters.
add_bad_address: That is not a web address. Use one that starts with http:// or https://.
add_file_too_big: The file is larger than {size} MB.
add_file_unreadable: The file could not be read.
add_tag_too_long: A tag is longer than {max} characters.
add_updated: Updated the earlier version. Passages stored: {chunks}.
add_degraded: Not indexed by meaning yet, so for now it is found by keywords.
add_timeout: No answer in time. It may already be stored. Reload the document list before trying again.
add_reference_placeholder: such as a web address, or a book and page
add_id_hint: Leave it empty and the id is made from what you add. Giving an id that already exists replaces that document.
add_bad_kind: A kind is one lowercase word, such as note, article or book.
add_ref_too_long: The reference is longer than {max} characters.
add_bad_id: An id uses letters, digits and . _ : / # @ - (up to {max} characters).
document_rebuilt: Rebuilt from the passages the Library stored: close to the original, not a faithful copy of it.
document_no_text: No text is stored for this document.
document_moved: The list changed since it was shown, so another document sits where this one was. Close this tab, load the list again and open the document from there.
documents_delete_timeout: No deletion reply. Reload documents to check before trying again.
index_timeout: No indexing reply. Refresh the counts before starting another batch.
index_degraded: Similarity indexing is unavailable. Keyword search still works.
communications_identity: Messages are sent as Ningo. Only configured channels appear here.
communications_no_content: Content unavailable. Check the bot's message content permission.
communications_uncertain: No delivery reply. Check the latest messages before sending again; it may already have arrived.
interfaces_hint: Switching an interface off stops it answering and receiving deliveries; its connection stays up.
link_steps: On the phone: WhatsApp > Settings > Linked devices > Link a device, then scan this code.
link_code_alt: Code to scan with the phone
communications_retention: The text of this conversation is kept on this machine for {days} days, then forgotten. Nothing else of it is kept.
communications_whatsapp_identity: Messages to a WhatsApp conversation go out from your own account, as you, as text only. A few a minute at most.
classification_explain: Choose the answers you know. Unanswered questions stay pending.
classification_reload_explain: Reload the current questions before submitting again. Your previous selections will be cleared.
experience_missing: This experience is no longer available. Reload the list.
experience_similarity: Similarity to the earlier example (not acceptance probability)
experience_feedback_hashtag: Give explicit hashtag feedback for the same meme. Keeping the suggested hashtag means accepted; choosing another means replaced. No feedback remains unknown. Verify which meme and attempt this refers to; repeated attempts cannot be disambiguated reliably from this record alone.
experience_feedback_explicit: An explicit observed outcome must be recorded for this exact experience reference. Missing feedback does not mean rejection.
experience_feedback_expired: This experience expired without an observed verdict. Expiry does not mean rejection.
experience_feedback_recorded: The outcome is already recorded. The first verdict is retained.
experience_feedback_unknown: Feedback requirements were not returned. Identify this action and its reference before recording an observed outcome.
experience_feedback_scope: Feedback records the outcome of this experience. It does not add or change a hashtag training example.
experience_feedback_confirm_scope: Confirm that you recognize this experience and know what happened. The first recorded outcome is retained.
experience_feedback_conflict: An outcome was already recorded: {outcome}. Your submission did not replace it.
experience_feedback_check: If the request timed out, the outcome is unknown. Refresh memory before trying again.
whatsapp_setup_missing: WhatsApp has not been set up. Configure the local WhatsApp gateway to link your account.
runtime_intro: Start only what you need. Required dependencies start with the module.
runtime_scope: Modules continue running after you close the desktop. Stopping preserves their data.
runtime_routing_hint: This pauses request handling while keeping the module running.
runtime_activity_unavailable: Activity and scheduled jobs will be available when the orchestrator responds.
runtime_logs_hint: Recent build and container output for this module. Updates every 2 seconds while open.
talk_voice_opening: I've read more than you'd guess. Ask.
talk_next_step: Ask anything, or start from one of these and finish the thought.
talk_hint: Enter sends · Shift+Enter breaks the line
talk_offline: Ningo is not answering. The orchestrator isn't running or can't be reached.
assistant_reading_intro: Ask Ningo what this reading means, challenge its argument or connect it to something else.
assistant_prompt_summary: Explain the main idea in plain language
assistant_prompt_question: What should I question in this argument?
assistant_prompt_critique: What is strong or weak about this piece?
assistant_excerpt_limit: Ningo uses the summary available in the feed, not the full article. It will tell you when it needs the complete text.
delivery_status_unknown: The orchestrator's state is unknown: starting it acts on the switches and jobs already saved.
delivery_discord_voice: Voice starts as well; Discord needs it.
delivery_discord_answers: The bot goes online, answers mentions and commands in Discord and receives Ningo's deliveries.
delivery_discord_switch_off: The discord switch is off: the bot goes online but neither answers nor receives deliveries.
delivery_scheduler_switch_off: The scheduler switch is off: no scheduled job runs until it is switched on.
delivery_scheduler_all_paused: Every scheduled job is paused: nothing runs until one is resumed.
delivery_job_posts: {name} runs every {interval} and posts memes to the meme channels on Discord.
delivery_job_refreshes: {name} runs every {interval} and refreshes the meme pool; it posts nothing.
settings_intro: Who Ningo talks to and the models it runs. Saved in the local database shared with CLI and TUI; affected modules are recreated.
settings_last_change: The last change did not finish: {message}
settings_webhooks_by_hand: Webhook channels are set in .env (DOKJA_DISCORD_WEBHOOKS) by hand: their addresses are credentials.
setting_hint_model: A model name; empty goes back to the default.
setting_recreated_later: Not running, recreated on their next start: {names}.
setting_sessions_end: Recreating the orchestrator ends the chat sessions in progress and briefly refuses every request.
setting_reindex: Memory and knowledge embed what they store again with the new model, a batch at a time.
providers_discovery_only: Discovery only. Authentication, quota and inference have not been tested. Listing models does not select one or start a service.
provider_registration_notice: Declarations remain unverified. Enabling permits discovery on refresh; existing inference settings stay in use.
provider_configuration_unavailable: Editing requires an updated runtime controller. Rebuild and restart it.
provider_models_hint: Up to 16 comma-separated model names; leave empty to clear.
chat_provider_hint: Declare a model above, then select it for chat. Selection does not test inference.
